summary: Frontend adds a client-side admin password check for "admin 9828" and attempts to persist it and refresh the actor/admin check. Backend changes shown focus on permission checks and add user profile APIs, but the diff does not show a backend-side password-based admin unlock mechanism or proof that admin-only methods are newly enforced via the provided password token.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement a simple password-based admin unlock so the user can access the admin dashboard and manage menu items using the password "admin 9828", with admin authorization enforced for all admin-only backend methods.
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend validates the password only client-side and stores it under the existing token key, but the backend diff does not show any logic that accepts this password/token to grant admin permission for the session (e.g., a login/unlock method, token verification, or mapping token->admin). Without backend-side unlock/verification shown, admin-only methods would still reject callers unless they are already admins by some other mechanism.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the /admin guard screen copy to use clear English and replace "Admin Token" wording with "Admin Password" (labels/placeholder/button).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff snippet shows the new constant ADMIN_PASSWORD and password error text, but does not include the rendered UI strings (labels/placeholder/button text) to confirm that "Admin Token" was replaced with "Admin Password" as required.

missing_requirements.requirement: Store the submitted admin password in session storage under the existing secret key "caffeineAdminToken" and recreate/refresh the actor and recheck admin status automatically (persisting across refresh in the same session).
missing_requirements.reason: AdminRouteGuard calls setSecretParameter('caffeineAdminToken', ...) but the diff does not show that this writes to sessionStorage (the requirement explicitly requires session storage). The urlParams.ts diff shows session storage helper functions, but the presence/behavior of setSecretParameter is not shown in the provided snippet, so persistence across refresh cannot be confirmed from the diff summary alone.
